info.title: ForgeX Authoritative API
info.description: Deterministic G-code and analytics authority API. G-code responses contain summary evidence without full toolpaths; analytics reports preserve auditable local-rule evidence.

post.summary: Estimate energy and itemized CNY cost for a completed owned G-code job
post.description: Only a succeeded owner-scoped job may be used. Time, mass and fingerprints come from its stored C# result, never the request. Supply all four nullable numeric inputs plus evidence; null means unknown, explicit zero is valid. Evidence is required when any number is supplied. Average power is a declared job average; machine hourly rate must exclude material and electricity. Duration excludes unmodeled warm-up, idle and holding time. No meter measurement or invoice is claimed. Energy rounds to 9 decimals, each cost to 6 using midpoint-to-even, total sums rounded components only when all inputs are known. The cost/2 SHA-256 binds model, basis and normalized inputs. No cost scenario is persisted. Request limit 16 KiB.

post.summary: Inspect bounded STL and 3MF geometry with Production part references
post.description: Requires the caller boundary. Raw bytes are not persisted. STL assumes millimeters. 3MF supports core geometry and Production namespace part references declared by the root model relationships. Object IDs are scoped by model part; part units are converted into parent units before applying reference transforms. Only the root build is executed; cross-part components in child models and unknown required extensions are rejected. This is geometry inspection, not full schema or UUID certification. Schema 1.1 checks edge adjacency, vertex fans and face-connected components using exact-coordinate welding. Self-intersection and overlaps are not checked. Volume is a geometric estimate and is null unless there is exactly one object and one face-connected component with closed edges, manifold vertices and consistent orientation. Shell containment and boolean union are not implemented. Limits: 64 MiB upload/declared ZIP expansion/actual XML expansion, 16 MiB XML, 256 ZIP entries, 250000 triangles, 4096 resource objects/instances and nesting depth 32. One request per process, 20 second timeout.
When PublicFacade is enabled, caller authentication follows DirectAuth and the trusted internal channel. RequireAuth rejects anonymous callers with 401.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with stable ForgeX extensions

nonManifoldVertices.description: Vertices with multiple incident face fans, invalid boundary degree or incident non-manifold edges after exact-coordinate welding.

vertexManifold.description: True when nonManifoldVertices is zero; boundary vertices are allowed. This is not a self-intersection or watertightness certification.

connectedComponents.description: Connected components of valid triangles joined by shared undirected edges. A shared vertex alone does not connect faces.
